card.name: Small words after money amounts
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "in", "of", "the" and "(" in general web prose, often right after a dollar amount like "$1.2 trillion". The contexts look mixed, and the pole is not tied to one clear word.

modes.label: Word after dollar amount
modes.description: The word "in" right after a figure in trillions or billions of dollars.
modes.example: total U.S. GDP grew from $6.1 trillion to $13.2 trillion<< in>> constant 2005 dollars.

modes.label: Linking word in a list or clause
modes.description: A small connecting word or verb inside a clause about files, loans or systems.
modes.example: files stored onto the Desktop and into<< the>> Documents-folder

modes.label: Opening bracket after a name
modes.description: A parenthesis opening an institution after a person's name in credits.
modes.example: R. O'Connell<< (>>University of Virginia), B. Whitmore

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in ordinary web text, especially after a money amount, with no firm medical meaning.
